adopted_question_verbatim: For the coffee-to-water ratio in my French press, did I switch to more water per tablespoon of coffee, or less?
adopted_answer_or_rubric_verbatim: Less water: from 6 to 5 ounces per tablespoon of coffee
english_rubric: Require less water; the change from six to five ounces per tablespoon substantiates the direction. Do not invert the ratio or assess coffee quality.
authorization: Use the approved factual question and answer unchanged.
